headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Washington Nationals, who won 7-1. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the final score 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance. The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Griffin Jax, a right-hander for the Tampa Bay Rays, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Cooper Pratt, a shortstop for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Jack Leiter, a right-hander for the Texas Rangers, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right ankle posterior impingement.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past few days. The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics have acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee.
